page.title: Steam Recon
page.description: Look up a Steam profile by SteamID, profile URL or vanity name.

welcomeScreen.title: Steam Recon
welcomeScreen.intro: Enter a SteamID64, SteamID3/2, a steamcommunity.com profile URL, or a vanity name and look it up.
welcomeScreen.description: Shows the profile summary, ban record, Steam level and game count, plus deep-links to external lookups. Requires a Steam Web API key under Settings > API Keys.

form.targetLabel: Steam ID, profile URL or vanity name

apiKey.notConfigured: Steam Recon needs a Steam Web API key. Add one under Settings > API Keys (free, but the Steam account must not be limited).

scan.pageDescription: Collects the target's friends graph, ranks close friends by mutual-connection weight, aggregates a geolocation hypothesis, and optionally scores a CS2 cheater-probability report.

form.targetLabel: Steam ID, profile URL or vanity name
form.maxFriendsHelper: Oldest connections first. Roughly {{count}} Steam API calls at this setting.
form.includeCsReportHelper: Also scores bans, account investment, CS2 stats and profile comments. Adds a few more calls and reads the target's public comments.

closeFriends.title: Close friends
closeFriends.subtitle: Ranked by mutual-connection weight with the target, not just friends-list order.

geolocation.title: Geolocation hypothesis
geolocation.subtitle: Weighted vote of connected friends' self-declared locations - a hypothesis, not a fact.
geolocation.coverage: {{voters}} connected friends voted, {{coverage}} had a usable location
geolocation.noHypothesis: Not enough data to form a location hypothesis

cheaterReport.title: CS2 cheater-probability report
cheaterReport.disclaimer: This is a transparent heuristic estimate based on public signals, not a verdict or proof of cheating.
cheaterReport.alreadyBanned: This account already has a VAC or game ban on record.

signals.title: Signals
signals.noData: No usable data for this signal

friendGraph.title: Friends graph
friendGraph.subtitle: The target and its top {{count}} close friends, sized and connected by mutual-connection weight.
friendGraph.empty: No connected friends to draw a graph from.
